missions.title: Boss: The Missing Birth Record

character.name: pani Kováčová
character.role: archivist at the Modra district archive

missions.briefing: You have arrived in Modra. The archive employee cannot find the family record. Greet her, explain that your great-grandfather was born near Modra (in Píla), answer her questions, and find out what to do next.

opening_line.slovak: Dobrý deň. Nech sa páči, ako vám môžem pomôcť?
opening_line.english: Good day. How can I help you?

elicit.slovak: Dobrý deň. Nech sa páči, ako vám môžem pomôcť?
elicit.english: Good day. How can I help you?

hints.text: How do Slovaks greet formally during the day?
She's asking for your name. 'I am called...'
Say: 'Volám sa' + your name — my name is...

objectives.hidden_goal: Explain that your great-grandfather was born near Modra (in Píla), using the past-tense structure.

elicit.slovak: A koho hľadáte? Povedzte mi o vašej rodine.
elicit.english: And who are you looking for? Tell me about your family.

ack.slovak: Aha, rozumiem. Prastarý otec, narodený pri Modre.
ack.english: Ah, I understand. Great-grandfather, born near Modra.

hints.text: Say who he was (prastarý otec), what happened (narodil sa), and where (v Píle / pri Modre).
Môj prastarý otec sa narodil v Píle, pri Modre.
Say: 'Môj prastarý otec sa narodil v Píle' — my great-grandfather was born in Píla.

objectives.hidden_goal: Understand and answer a follow-up question about the year of birth.

elicit.slovak: Dobre. A v ktorom roku sa narodil?
elicit.english: Good. And in which year was he born?

hints.text: She's asking WHEN — the year of birth. Answer with a year, or say you don't know.
Say a year ('v roku 1898') or 'Neviem' — I don't know.

objectives.hidden_goal: The archivist misheard the birthplace. Notice it and correct her.

elicit.slovak: Moment... takže váš prastarý otec sa narodil v Bratislave, áno?
elicit.english: One moment... so your great-grandfather was born in Bratislava, yes?

ack.slovak: Prepáčte, máte pravdu — Píla, pri Modre. Nie Bratislava.
ack.english: Apologies, you're right — Píla, near Modra. Not Bratislava.

hints.text: She got the town wrong. Disagree, then repeat the correct place.
Nie, narodil sa v Píle, pri Modre.
Say: 'Nie, v Píle' — no, in Píla.

objectives.hidden_goal: Ask where the record is or what she needs, and obtain the next step.

elicit.english: Unfortunately we don't have that record here.

ack.slovak: Staršia matrika pre Pílu je v štátnom archíve v Modre. Choďte tam a pýtajte si rodnú matriku, rok 1898.
ack.english: The older registry for Píla is in the state archive in Modra. Go there and ask for the birth registry, year 1898.

hints.text: The record isn't here. Ask WHERE it is (kde je...?).
Ask: 'Kde je ten záznam?' — where is the record?

completion_line.english: Good luck with the search. Goodbye!
